content.title: Portal - An Immersive Spatial Audio App For Focus, Sleep & Relaxation
content.text: Stress Less. Focus Better. Sleep More. Portal brings the transformative power of the natural world back into modern life, helping you to reimagine how you work, rest and sleep. Try free on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Key Features Re-Creating Nature in Immersive Detail. Motion Visuals Stunning window-like views of nature captured using digital cinema cameras in up to 12K resolution. Spatial Audio Life-like pristine sounds of nature brought to you in immersive detail with headtracked Spatial Audio. Smart Lighting Room-level immersion with smart lighting support for Nanoleaf, Philips Hue and HomeKit (on iOS).
